content:
Arjun Patel: Hi everyone! Arjun here — joining infra from Toronto. I collect bonsai, make modular synth loops, and have a mischievous ferret named Pickle. Super excited to be here. Any tips for surviving week one? :wave:
Marta Liu: Welcome Arjun! Biggest tip: bring snacks for badge day. Also join the #vinyl and #plants channels if you want people to adopt your bonsai pics. :seedling::record_button:
Devon Cruz: Welcome! If youre in SF, theres a weekly after-work at The Alley (boardgames). Otherwise, we do virtual hangouts on Fridays. :boardgame:
onboard-bot: Heads up: new hire orientation tomorrow 10:00 PST. Check your email for the agenda and zoom link.
Samir Gupta: Ferret owner!!! Please post photos. Also would love to hear a synth loop sometime during lunch. Im down for a demo (Im amateur but enthusiastic). :grin:
Arjun Patel: Will definitely post Pickle pics and a 2-minute synth demo. Also asking for sandwich recs near the office — spice tolerant preferred.
Marta Liu: Lola's Deli has a spicy roasted pepper sandwich, two blocks away. And the food truck on Wednesdays does a killer kimchi grilled cheese.
Nita Ramos: Quick logistic: stop by reception at 9:30 for badge + laptop pickup to avoid the queue. See you tomorrow!
Arjun Patel: Thanks all  looking forward to meeting folks in person and bringing snacks next week. :raised_hands:
